title_original: The Hulett Collection : Visits to the Paris Studio of Louis Stettner

blocks.text: Private visits to the Paris studio of Louis Stettner are open again during Paris Photo week for a fifth year. From November 9 to 14, collectors are invited to spend an hour inside the studio, with appointments available between 10am and 6pm each day, Paris time.

Each visit is one hour and limited to a single party of up to ten guests, so you can take your time. You will see original prints, contact sheets and personal materials from a career that moved between Paris and New York, with the Estate of Louis Stettner there to welcome you.
To protect the studio’s privacy, the address is shared only once your appointment is confirmed. A selection of works available from the studio is shown below. Please click here to book your visit.
The Hulett Collection 1311 E 15th St, Tulsa, OK 74120 www.thehulettcollection.com
